aberrant-dragonmark.summary: A wild, unpredictable dragonmark: Sorcerer magic cast with CON, a save boost and Hit Die surges.

Aberrant Fortitude.summary: Reaction on a failed CON save: add 1d4 to it, possibly turning it into a success. Once per Long Rest.

Aberrant Magic.summary: Learn one Sorcerer cantrip and pick a level 1 Sorcerer spell that is always prepared; cast that spell once per Short or Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. CON is your spellcasting ability here.

Aberrant Surge.summary: Casting this feat's level 1 spell, you may spend and roll a Hit Point Die: an even result grants that many Temp HP; an odd one deals that much Force damage to another creature within 30 ft (to you if there is none).

boon-of-siberys.summary: An epic boon drawing on the Siberys mark for one powerful spell.

Aberrant Magic.summary: Pick a level 8 or lower Sorcerer spell or one from the Siberys table; it is always prepared, castable once per Short or Long Rest with no slot or components, otherwise with your slots. Cast it with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

choices.note: or pick from the Siberys mark's own spell table instead
choices.label: Aberrant Magic spell

Siberys Dragonmark Spells.summary: Table picks, each with a suggested mark: Animal Shapes, Control Weather, Demiplane, Heroes' Feast, Maze, Mind Blank, Plane Shift, Project Image, Regenerate, Symbol, Teleport, True Seeing.

greater-aberrant-mark.summary: A stronger aberrant mark: a tougher save boost and cantrips that burn Hit Dice for Temp HP and Force damage.

Improved Fortitude.summary: Aberrant Fortitude rolls 1d6 instead of 1d4 and comes back on a Short or Long Rest.

Mark of Inspiration.summary: On casting a cantrip, roll one or two unspent Hit Point Dice and spend them: gain Temp HP equal to the roll + CON mod, and another creature of your choice within 30 ft takes that much Force damage. PB times per Long Rest.

greater-mark-of-detection.summary: A stronger mark of detection that lets an ally share your sight of the unseen.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Deductive Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Shared Detection.summary: When Magical Detection casts See Invisibility without a slot, one creature you see within 30 ft also gets its benefits for the duration.

greater-mark-of-finding.summary: A stronger mark of finding whose quarry can't hide behind invisibility.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Hunter’s Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Finding.summary: A slot-free Hunter's Mark from Finder's Magic has double range, and you may stop its target from benefiting from being Invisible while it lasts.

greater-mark-of-handling.summary: A stronger mark of handling for riders and beast tamers.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Wild Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Handling.summary: While mounted, when your melee attack hits a target within 5 ft of the mount, the mount may at once spend its Reaction on one attack or on moving as far as its Speed.

Subdue Animal.summary: Magic action: a Beast or Monstrosity you see within 30 ft makes a WIS save (DC 8 + PB + WIS) or is Frightened until the start of your next turn. PB times per Long Rest.

greater-mark-of-healing.summary: A stronger mark of healing: more free Cure Wounds and steadier healing rolls.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Medical Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Healing.summary: Healing Touch's slot-free Cure Wounds can be cast PB times per Long Rest. Any 1 or 2 on Cure Wounds healing dice counts as a 3.

greater-mark-of-hospitality.summary: A stronger mark of hospitality whose meals revive the weary.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Ever Hospitable die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Inspired Hospitality.summary: Once per Long Rest, Purify Food and Drink can instead refresh creatures of your choice within 30 ft: each loses 1 Exhaustion level and gains Temp HP equal to PB + your INT, WIS or CHA mod (picked with the feat).

greater-mark-of-making.summary: A stronger mark of making that empowers weapons further.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Artisan’s Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Making.summary: A slot-free Magic Weapon from Spellsmith is cast as a level 3 spell.

greater-mark-of-passage.summary: A stronger mark of passage that teleports companions along with you.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Intuitive Motion die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Inspired Passage.summary: A slot-free Misty Step from Magical Passage can bring up to two willing creatures you see within 30 ft: each may spend its Reaction to teleport up to 30 ft to a free spot in its sight.

greater-mark-of-scribing.summary: A stronger mark of scribing that links allies' minds.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Gifted Scribe die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Inspired Scribing.summary: Once per Long Rest, Comprehend Languages can also cover up to three willing creatures you see within 30 ft; while it lasts, you and they can talk telepathically within 1 mile of each other.

greater-mark-of-sentinel.summary: A stronger mark of the sentinel that strikes back when guarding.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Sentinel’s Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Sentinel.summary: Vigilant Guardian's Reaction also lets you make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike.

greater-mark-of-shadow.summary: A stronger mark of shadow that hides more than one.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Cunning Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Shadow.summary: A slot-free Invisibility from Shape Shadows is cast as a level 3 spell.

greater-mark-of-storm.summary: A stronger mark of storm that lets you ride the wind.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Windwright’s Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Storm.summary: A slot-free Gust of Wind from Storm Magic also gives you a 60 ft Fly Speed while the spell lasts.

greater-mark-of-warding.summary: A stronger mark of warding that turns attacks aside.

Improved Intuition.summary: Your Warder’s Intuition die becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Warding.summary: Reaction: give Disadvantage to an attack roll aimed at you or at a creature you see within 30 ft. PB times per Long Rest.

mark-of-detection.summary: The mark of detection: sharper investigation and insight, plus spells that reveal magic and poison.

Deductive Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Investigation and Insight checks.

Magical Detection.summary: Detect Magic and Detect Poison and Disease are always prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. From level 3, See Invisibility joins them on the same terms. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Detection Spells.summary: 1st: Detect Evil and Good, Identify; 2nd: Detect Thoughts, Find Traps; 3rd: Clairvoyance, Nondetection; 4th: Arcane Eye, Divination; 5th: Legend Lore.

mark-of-finding.summary: The mark of finding: a tracker's senses and magic for marking and locating quarry.

Hunter’s Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Perception and Survival checks.

Finder’s Magic.summary: Hunter's Mark is always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. From level 3, Locate Object joins it on the same terms. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Finding Spells.summary: 1st: Faerie Fire, Longstrider; 2nd: Locate Animals or Plants, Mind Spike; 3rd: Clairvoyance, Speak with Plants; 4th: Divination, Locate Creature; 5th: Commune with Nature.

mark-of-handling.summary: The mark of handling: a bond with beasts, and later with simple monstrosities.

Wild Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Nature and Animal Handling checks.

Primal Connection.summary: Animal Friendship and Speak with Animals are always prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Monstrous Connections.summary: From level 3, Animal Friendship and Speak with Animals can also target a Monstrosity whose INT is 3 or lower.

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Handling Spells.summary: 1st: Command, Find Familiar; 2nd: Beast Sense, Calm Emotions; 3rd: Beacon of Hope, Conjure Animals; 4th: Aura of Life, Dominate Beast; 5th: Awaken.

mark-of-healing.summary: The mark of healing: medical skill and restorative magic.

Medical Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Medicine checks and to checks made with a Herbalism Kit.

Healing Touch.summary: Cure Wounds is always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. From level 3, Lesser Restoration joins it on the same terms. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Healing Spells.summary: 1st: False Life, Healing Word; 2nd: Arcane Vigor, Prayer of Healing; 3rd: Aura of Vitality, Mass Healing Word; 4th: Aura of Life, Aura of Purity; 5th: Greater Restoration.

mark-of-hospitality.summary: The mark of hospitality: a gracious host's charm and household magic.

Ever Hospitable.summary: Add 1d4 to your Persuasion checks and to checks made with Brewer's Supplies or Cook's Utensils.

Innkeeper’s Magic.summary: Purify Food and Drink and Unseen Servant are always prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. From level 3, Calm Emotions joins them on the same terms. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Hospitality Spells.summary: 1st: Goodberry, Sleep; 2nd: Aid, Enhance Ability; 3rd: Create Food and Water, Leomund's Tiny Hut; 4th: Aura of Purity, Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum; 5th: Hallow.

mark-of-making.summary: The mark of making: a crafter's knack and magic that mends and empowers gear.

Artisan’s Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Arcana checks and to checks made with Artisan's Tools.

Spellsmith.summary: Know Mending; Magic Weapon is always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list. 1st: Identify, Tenser's Floating Disk; 2nd: Continual Flame, Spiritual Weapon; 3rd: Conjure Barrage, Elemental Weapon; 4th: Fabricate, Stone Shape; 5th: Creation.

mark-of-passage.summary: The mark of passage: swift feet and short-range teleportation.

Intuitive Motion.summary: Add 1d4 to your Athletics and Acrobatics checks.

Magical Passage.summary: Misty Step is always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Passage Spells.summary: 1st: Expeditious Retreat, Jump; 2nd: Find Steed, Pass without Trace; 3rd: Blink, Phantom Steed; 4th: Dimension Door, Freedom of Movement; 5th: Teleportation Circle.

mark-of-scribing.summary: The mark of scribing: a gift for script, language and distant messages.

Gifted Scribe.summary: Add 1d4 to your History checks and to checks made with Calligrapher's Supplies.

Scribe’s Insight.summary: Know Message; Comprehend Languages is always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. From level 3, Magic Mouth joins it on the same terms. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Scribing Spells.summary: 1st: Command, Illusory Script; 2nd: Animal Messenger, Silence; 3rd: Sending, Tongues; 4th: Arcane Eye, Confusion; 5th: Dream.

mark-of-sentinel.summary: The mark of the sentinel: a bodyguard's vigilance and protective magic.

Sentinel’s Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Insight and Perception checks.

Guardian’s Shield.summary: Shield is always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Vigilant Guardian.summary: Reaction when a creature you see within 5 ft is hit by an attack roll: trade places with it and take the hit yourself. PB times per Long Rest.

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Sentinel Spells.summary: 1st: Compelled Duel, Shield of Faith; 2nd: Warding Bond, Zone of Truth; 3rd: Counterspell, Protection from Energy; 4th: Death Ward, Guardian of Faith; 5th: Bigby's Hand.

mark-of-shadow.summary: The mark of shadow: stealth, showmanship and illusions.

Cunning Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Stealth and Performance checks.

Shape Shadows.summary: Know Minor Illusion; Invisibility is always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Shadow Spells.summary: 1st: Disguise Self, Silent Image; 2nd: Darkness, Pass without Trace; 3rd: Clairvoyance, Major Image; 4th: Greater Invisibility, Hallucinatory Terrain; 5th: Mislead.

mark-of-storm.summary: The mark of storm: command over wind and weather, and a shrug at lightning.

Windwright’s Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Acrobatics checks and to checks made with Navigator's Tools.

Storm Magic.summary: Know Thunderclap. From level 3, Gust of Wind is always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Storm Spells.summary: 1st: Feather Fall, Fog Cloud; 2nd: Levitate, Shatter; 3rd: Sleet Storm, Wind Wall; 4th: Conjure Minor Elementals, Control Water; 5th: Conjure Elemental.

mark-of-warding.summary: The mark of warding: a locksmith's eye and spells that guard and seal.

Warder’s Intuition.summary: Add 1d4 to your Investigation checks and to checks made with Thieves' Tools.

Wards and Seals.summary: Alarm and Mage Armor are always prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. From level 3, Arcane Lock joins them on the same terms. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Spells of the Mark.summary: With Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the mark's spell table joins that feature's spell list.

Mark of Warding Spells.summary: 1st: Armor of Agathys, Sanctuary; 2nd: Knock, Nystul's Magic Aura; 3rd: Glyph of Warding, Magic Circle; 4th: Leomund's Secret Chest, Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound; 5th: Antilife Shell.

potent-dragonmark.summary: Masters any dragonmark: its whole spell table stays prepared, with a bonus slot for mark spells.

Ability Score Increase.summary: +1 to the ability your Dragonmark feat casts with, max 20.

Dragonmark Preparation.summary: Every spell on your Spells of the Mark table is always prepared.

Dragonmark Spellcasting.summary: One extra spell slot of half your level rounded up (max level 5), usable only for spells your Dragonmark feat or this feat prepares. Regained on a Short or Long Rest.
